description: This source file defines the PdfComboBoxField class, a specialized class representing a combo box field within a PDF form, including properties for handling selected index and value, as well as constructors and metadata.

classes.name: PdfComboBoxField
classes.description: Represents a PDF combo box form field, inheriting from PdfChoiceField, with properties and methods to get/set selected index and value.

classes.name: PdfComboBoxField.Keys
classes.description: Contains predefined dictionary keys specific to PdfComboBoxField, inheriting from PdfAcroField.Keys.

methods.name: SelectedIndex
methods.description: Gets or sets the index of the currently selected item in the combo box.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Gets or sets the value of the combo box field, updating the selected index accordingly.
